name: form-dialog
title: Form Dialog
description: A Form inside a Dialog: a scrolling body with a sticky footer, Escape and outside presses blocked while pending, closes on success and returns focus, asks before discarding unsaved changes, and an optional review step before submitting.
docs: `<FormDialog trigger title description size schema defaultValues onSubmit submitLabel cancelLabel>` with `FormField`s as children; or control it with `open`/`onOpenChange`. It takes every `Form` prop (`messages`, `disableWhilePending`…) and `FormActions`' `tone`, `confirm` and `secondaryAction`. While `onSubmit` runs, Escape, outside presses and Cancel do nothing; it closes when `onSubmit` resolves and focus returns to the trigger, or to `returnFocus` (UI SDK `finalFocus`). A thrown error keeps it open with the errors on the fields and in the root error. `confirmDiscard="Discard changes?"` asks before Escape, an outside press or Cancel closes it with unsaved changes (`discardLabel`, `keepEditingLabel`). `reviewStep={{ render: (values) => …, editLabel, confirmLabel }}`: submit validates and shows the review, edit returns to the fields with the values kept, confirm runs `onSubmit`; a field error from the server returns to the fields. The body scrolls between the header and the actions, and on narrow screens it is a bottom sheet.
